occupations.title: Online Merchants
occupations.rationale: The product is an eCommerce platform that enables users to 'Build your store' and 'Launch your store today', which are the central activities of an online merchant.

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: The software enables users to 'Sell seamlessly on platforms like Google, Meta, and TikTok' and 'optimize titles, descriptions, and metadata' to improve brand discovery, which are key responsibilities for marketing managers.

occupations.title: General and Operations Managers
occupations.rationale: The platform serves as a central system to 'run both B2C speed, B2B depth... from one place' and integrates with operational tools like 'ERP, CRM, PIM, WMS', aligning with the oversight responsibilities of a general or operations manager.
